summary: Local verify and pre-push run only affected tests from the first round; CI keeps the full suite

options.description: Every verify round and pre-push run vitest only for packages changed against origin/main plus their pnpm dependents, and within those packages only the test files related to the changed files (vitest --changed/related); node --test gates run through a path map; build, lint, format, typecheck always run; any root config, lockfile, package.json, tsconfig, vitest config or gate-runner change, an unmapped path, or an unreadable record forces the full run; CI keeps the full suite and coverage floors
Same as affected-from-first-round but at package granularity only (no vitest file-level narrowing, gates still all run)
Keep DEC-0372 as is: full first round, affected packages on later rounds

body: Extends DEC-0372. Today the first verify round of every executor task runs vitest for every workspace package (touched packages under test:coverage, the rest plain) plus every node --test gate, and the pre-push patch-coverage copy runs test:coverage for whole touched packages. Two executors doing this at once held the 12-core machine at load 15 to 21 on 2026-11-22 (about 10 parallel tsc processes plus vitest pools per run), which also drives EXECUTOR CAP to 0. CI's full suite on GitHub runners stays the merge gate, so the local full run duplicates it. Operator ruled 2026-11-22 in the planner session: run only the changed code and its dependents locally. Narrows the verify control (AISDLC-1086, DEC-0372), hence the weakening tag.
